title: Use a status-immune converter and preserve the endgame finisher
intent: Use a status-immune or resistant recruit to convert a hostile status matchup, then spend replaceable pivots while preserving the type-specific endgame attacker.

scope.claim: tested only against Camper Gavi with the recorded level-17 party and policy

requirements: complete enemy roster and fresh battle-RAM identity
full HP and PP with the recorded party order
Croagunk with Fake Out, Vacuum Wave, Mud Shot, and Sludge
identity-based switching because active battlers move to party slot 0
line: use the ordinary lead and Electric pivot to remove Bibarel
use the Ground reserve and priority fallback against Ponyta
introduce the status-immune converter against Eelektrik, then pivot through expendable resources
preserve Croagunk's Sludge for Sunflora and Staravia's Aerial Ace for Dustox
blockers: an unknown trainer reserve, ability, held item, move, or send-out branch
Croagunk unavailable for Sunflora with no healthy Flying fallback
Staravia damaged below a freshly certified Dustox survival bound
abort_rules: actual HP, PP, status, species, or settled battle text differs from the certified result
the fresh certificate no longer offers the recorded action
a no-input observation changes battle state after the verifier returns
